scope: Six exact base-text degree/comparison adverbs: five bolj and one boljše.
choice: Normalize all six adverbial sites to official bolje; preserve genuine bolši adjective forms.
motivation: All six modify degree or comparison. Official grammar explicitly distinguishes adverb bolje from adjective bolši; bolj is only a Slovenian comparator surface.
alternatives_rejected: A root-wide change could corrupt bolšim/bolšego/bolšej adjectives.
Retaining bolj/boljše leaves non-headword adverb forms.
